name: Tennis Academy (Ages 11-18)
description_short: A tennis day camp for ages 11-18 at the Weymouth Club, run by USPTR/USPTA pros, from 9:00 a.m. to 3:00 p.m. Each day includes live-ball hitting, drills, match play with a weekly ladder, fitness, and an elective such as tennis games or free swim.
swim_waterfront_notes: Free swim is offered as one of the 2:15-3:00 electives. The page does not say anything about swim testing or lifeguards.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page
TFA Traditional Track page: '2026 / 2027 dates' table covering TFA and Tennis Academy

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season (June 15 – Sept 4, 2026), which has already ended. No 2027 dates or prices are listed.

The only links on the page that look like registration links go to Dance pages (dance parent portal and dance tuition), not to camp registration. For camp registration, the page says to use the TFA Traditional Track page.
Extended care costs $15/hour for members and $17/hour for non-members. Late pickup after 5:00 p.m. costs $1 per minute. The page gives no camp tuition.
The camp says it is licensed by the Weymouth Board of Health under 105 CMR 430. ACA accreditation is not mentioned.
unknowns: Registration link for Tennis Academy (the page points to the TFA Traditional Track page)
Whether weekly sessions or single days can be booked, and how
Swim supervision and swim test policy
Support for campers with special needs
